SELECT 
    vendregistry,
    ROUND(
        (vendrate * 10) + 
        (CAST(vendsucccount AS numeric) / vendtxcount) * 50 + 
        (CASE vendchecklvl 
            WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Premium' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
         END) * 15 - 
        (CAST(venddisputecount AS numeric) / vendtxcount) * 100, 
    2) AS vendor_relationship_strength
FROM vendors
WHERE vendtxcount > 0
ORDER BY vendor_relationship_strength;
